frozen_body: W05 contrasts Euclidean and Minkowski reality: the Euclidean twistor real structure acts on PT itself and preserves the CP1 fibers, while the Minkowski reality structure naturally maps PT to its dual and interchanges spinor chirality.

compositional_interface.provider_rule: W098 supplies the Euclidean PT real-structure authority and 943099; W047 supplies the corrected reference right-spinor plane 990110; the conjugate-semilinear schema supplies 944000; remaining field/vector/projective roles are contained in those validated support graphs.

reconstruction.chiral_exchange: right plane <-> dual-left annihilator; left plane <-> dual-right annihilator

semantic_guards: The dual twistor space is represented by an exact four-dimensional complex carrier with a nondegenerate pairing against T, not by a name-only node.
Dual chiral subspaces are exact annihilators of the opposite source chiral planes.
The Minkowski reality map is an exact conjugate-semilinear bijection and its induced projective map is total.
The Euclidean side is reused from current W098 authority and remains a self-map of PT.
No SU(2,2) orbit/signature semantics are imported; those remain W-SSC-052.
No Lisi or cross-track semantics are used.
